pricing.credits.advanced: Use your monthly AI credits to run supported basic models and selected advanced models. Credit usage varies by model. You can also use your own API key at your provider’s rates, even after your credits run out.
pricing.credits.basic: Use your one-time AI credits to run supported basic models. Credit usage varies by model. You can also use your own API key at your provider’s rates, even after your credits run out.

pricing.logs.limited: Up to {{count,number}} days of app logs
pricing.logs.paidNote: Conversation logs are retained while your paid subscription is active. Older workflow run logs are archived monthly. Workspace owners and admins can download archives under Settings → Archived logs. Only workspace owners can delete an entire month’s archive.
pricing.logs.sandboxNote: App execution and conversation logs are retained for up to 30 days and automatically deleted afterward.
pricing.processing.professionalTooltip: Knowledge documents receive priority in the processing and indexing queue.
pricing.processing.sandboxTooltip: Knowledge documents use the standard processing and indexing queue.
pricing.processing.teamTooltip: Knowledge documents receive the highest priority in the processing and indexing queue.
pricing.runs.tooltip: Includes 500 app runs per workspace per month. Each app execution counts as one run when it starts. Runs are shared across your workspace.
pricing.storage.label: {{amount}} {{unit}} knowledge base vector storage
pricing.storage.tooltip: High Quality indexing stores vectors so your knowledge base can find content by meaning. This quota measures the space those vectors use, not the size of the files you upload.
pricing.triggers.professionalTooltip: Events that automatically start workflows through schedule, webhook, or plugin triggers. Includes 20,000 trigger events per month.
pricing.triggers.sandboxTooltip: Trigger events automatically start workflows through schedule, webhook, or plugin triggers. Sandbox includes 1,000 trigger events in total, with no monthly reset.
pricing.triggers.teamTooltip: No trigger event limit. Events that automatically start workflows through schedule, webhook, or plugin triggers.
